newsOverlay.marketBias: Macro liquidity risk remains restrictive: Fed hike pricing is near 89-90%, oil remains around $108 amid unresolved Middle East supply disruption, the U.S. dollar is firmer and global risk assets are under pressure. The overlay remains PREPARE VOLATILITY; intelligence alone creates neither a buy nor a sell signal.

items.headline: Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan now expect a September Fed hike as inflation and oil pressures persist
items.summary: Reuters reports Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan now expect the Federal Reserve to raise rates by 25 basis points at the September meeting, while market pricing puts the probability near 87%. The shift follows firm inflation data and oil prices above $100 amid Middle East supply stress.
items.whyItMatters: A higher probability of renewed Fed tightening can lift Treasury yields and the dollar and reduce risk-asset liquidity, creating a material headwind for crypto ahead of the September 16 decision.
items.actionReason: This materially strengthens the restrictive-liquidity setup ahead of the scheduled FOMC decision, but it does not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW and is not a sell instruction.

items.headline: Oil jumps more than 2% as Saudi and Hormuz disruptions transmit into markets
items.summary: Reuters reports Brent around $108 and WTI around $103 in Monday trading after new Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia, Gulf vessel attacks and the Saudi East-West pipeline shutdown. The move confirms that the physical supply shock is still feeding directly into energy prices.
items.whyItMatters: Oil above $100 with renewed upside pressure can reinforce inflation expectations, high bond yields and tighter global risk liquidity, which is a material headwind for crypto even without a crypto-specific failure.
items.actionReason: This is a market-price confirmation of the existing energy shock, but it does not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW and is not a buy or sell signal.

items.headline: Oman postpones planned Iran-Gulf Hormuz meeting; no new date announced
items.summary: Reuters reports Oman's foreign minister said the planned Monday meeting between Gulf states and Iran has been postponed. No replacement date was announced in the verified report.
items.whyItMatters: The postponement removes the most immediate scheduled diplomatic path toward a temporary Hormuz navigation arrangement, extending uncertainty around oil supply, inflation, yields and crypto risk liquidity.
items.actionReason: This is a material reversal of the previously scheduled HIGH catalyst, but it is not a direct crypto protocol failure and does not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW.

items.headline: Saudi pipeline outage could threaten roughly 4% of global oil supply if repairs drag on
items.summary: Reuters reports the damaged Saudi East-West pipeline had been rerouting about 4 million barrels per day and could materially reduce exports if not restored within days. Industry repair estimates vary, with some extending to six weeks, while Yanbu storage may cover only about five to seven days of exports.
items.whyItMatters: A prolonged loss of Saudi bypass capacity would deepen the energy-supply shock, sustain inflation pressure and high yields, and tighten global risk-asset liquidity including crypto.
items.actionReason: The repair-duration and storage constraints materially extend the pipeline shutdown risk, but this is not a direct crypto protocol failure and does not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW.

items.headline: Iran-Oman understanding does not provide for immediate reopening of Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Reuters reports an Iranian source said the Iran-Oman understanding lays groundwork for a possible future reopening of Hormuz but does not provide for immediate reopening. The Oman meeting that had been expected to discuss the issue has since been postponed.
items.whyItMatters: Failure to reopen Hormuz promptly prolongs the oil-supply, inflation, yields and risk-liquidity shock affecting crypto and other risk assets.
items.actionReason: This confirms persistence of the energy shock, but it is not a direct crypto protocol failure and does not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW.

items.headline: Trump says Iran probably responsible for attack on Saudi East-West oil pipeline
items.summary: Reuters reports President Donald Trump said Iran was probably responsible for the aerial attack on Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline after speaking with Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. The attribution is not proof of responsibility, but it raises escalation risk around already-disrupted Middle East energy infrastructure.
items.whyItMatters: Direct U.S. political attribution can increase retaliation and escalation risk, potentially extending the oil, inflation, yields and risk-liquidity shock affecting crypto.
items.actionReason: Material escalation risk, but responsibility remains unverified and this is not a direct crypto protocol failure; no independent REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW trigger.

items.headline: Saudi Arabia shuts East-West oil pipeline after drone attack as Houthis seize Perim Island
items.summary: Reuters reports Saudi Arabia temporarily shut its East-West pipeline after a drone attack originating from Iraq, while Iran-aligned Houthis seized Perim Island at the mouth of the Red Sea. The pipeline had been moving roughly 4-5 million barrels per day, about 4-5% of global supply.
items.whyItMatters: A simultaneous threat to Saudi overland bypass capacity and Red Sea transit can intensify the existing energy shock, lift inflation expectations and yields, and tighten global risk-asset liquidity including crypto.
items.actionReason: This is a material escalation of the existing macro/energy risk regime, but it is not a direct crypto protocol failure and does not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW.

items.headline: Oil tanker freight rates hit record highs as Middle East shipping attacks tighten capacity
items.summary: Reuters reports VLCC rates from the Gulf of Oman to China reached a record Worldscale 450, equivalent to roughly $11.50 per barrel, after attacks on shipping reduced available tanker capacity.
items.whyItMatters: Record physical oil-transport costs reinforce the inflation and financial-conditions channel already weighing on global risk assets and crypto liquidity.
items.actionReason: This materially extends the existing energy/logistics shock but does not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW.

items.headline: ECB policymakers open door to further rate hikes if energy shock persists
items.summary: Reuters reports Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel and Estonia's central bank governor Ulo Kaasik signaled further ECB rate increases may be needed if energy prices keep feeding inflation.
items.whyItMatters: A broader global tightening cycle can keep yields and funding conditions restrictive for crypto.
items.actionReason: The hawkish follow-through extends the restrictive-liquidity regime but does not independently justify REDUCE REVIEW or EXIT REVIEW.

catalysts.headline: U.S. Senate procedural vote on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act
catalysts.summary: Reuters reports the Senate is set for a pivotal procedural vote on the Clarity Act on September 15; the vote concerns whether the Senate proceeds with the digital-asset market-structure bill, not final passage.
catalysts.whyItMatters: The vote can materially alter expectations for U.S. crypto market-structure regulation and therefore regulatory risk premia across major digital assets.
catalysts.actionReason: HIGH regulatory catalyst inside seven days but not yet inside the six-hour notification window.

catalysts.headline: Federal Reserve FOMC rate decision, SEP and press conference
catalysts.summary: The Federal Reserve calendar confirms the two-day FOMC meeting on September 15-16, with the policy decision at 2:00 p.m. ET and press conference at 2:30 p.m. ET on September 16.
catalysts.whyItMatters: The rate decision and projections can materially reset yields, the dollar and global crypto liquidity.
catalysts.actionReason: Reliable HIGH catalyst inside the next seven days but not yet inside the 24-hour volatility window.
